clue.text: Fat belly where fat cat might be?

definitions.meaning: a jocular old word for a large paunch
a fat cat is an overpaid executive, found in a big company

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both humorous slang for a paunch and a large business firm, the natural habitat of a highly paid boss.

clue.text: Unconscious as it happens, survive

parts.note: someone knocked unconscious is out
a broadcast shown as it happens is live

explanation.surface: Someone passed out in real time but pulled through.
explanation.definitionFit: To last longer than another, or survive them, is to live past them.

clue.text: Different lever is up in mill

indicators.note: different signals that the letters of lever is up are made into something else

explanation.surface: A new lever is raised in a factory.
explanation.definitionFit: To grind something into powder is what a mill does.

clue.text: Punk band's leader inspired by Scottish dance!

indicators.note: inspired, read as breathed in, says the letter is taken inside the dance

parts.note: a reel is a lively Scottish dance

indicators.note: leader takes the first letter of the word band's

explanation.surface: A punk group's frontman takes ideas from a Highland dance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inspired by' puts B, the leader of 'band's', inside REEL.
explanation.definitionFit: A punk is a nonconformist who defies convention, a rebellious type.

clue.text: Aintree awkward for colt

indicators.note: awkward implies the letters of Aintree are put clumsily out of place

explanation.surface: Aintree, the Liverpool racecourse, is a tricky course for a young horse.
explanation.walkthrough: AINTREE is the racecourse of the Grand National, so 'colt' looks like a horse; it means a novice, as in cricket.
explanation.definitionFit: A colt is a young, inexperienced player, someone still learning.

clue.text: Very ripe vegetable, mate!

parts.note: very ripe in the sense of aged means old
a bean is a vegetable

explanation.surface: A greengrocer shouts about an overripe vegetable.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is an old-fashioned British form of address, like 'old chap'.
explanation.definitionFit: A dated, chummy British form of address equals friend or pal.

clue.text: Lower one's guard and fail as wicketkeeper?

definitions.meaning: a wicketkeeper in cricket who fails to hold a catch lets it fall

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to blunder or slip up, and literally describes a fielder fumbling a catch.

clue.text: Cake with grains, almost all eaten up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up says the whole assembly is read from bottom to top
eaten says the shortened word is swallowed by the grains

parts.note: rice is eaten as grains

indicators.note: almost says the word all loses its final letter

parts.note: all is the word to be shortened

explanation.surface: A cake made with grains has nearly all been consumed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims the last letter, 'eaten' sets the short word inside the grains, and 'up' turns the whole thing over, as the down clue reads upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A choux pastry finger filled with cream is a small cake.

clue.text: Performance thereafter recalled, hundred and one crammed in

indicators.note: crammed in says the two short pieces are packed inside the reversed word
recalled, read as called back, turns the word for thereafter round

parts.note: thereafter means later
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A show is remembered afterwards, with a hundred and one items squeezed into it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recalled' reverses the synonym of thereafter, and 'crammed in' packs the two Roman numerals into its middle.
explanation.definitionFit: A musical concert by a soloist is a kind of performance.

clue.text: Make last of energy drink

parts.note: a make of goods is a brand

indicators.note: last of tells us to take only the final letter of the word energy

explanation.surface: An instruction to make the final bit of an energy drink go further.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Make last' reads as one phrase meaning prolong; split it, 'Make' is the brand and 'last of' picks Y from 'energy'.
explanation.definitionFit: A spirit distilled from wine is a common alcoholic drink.

clue.text: We needn't use rocks — sharp, perhaps?

indicators.note: rocks, as a verb meaning shakes, tells us to jumble the letters of we needn't use

explanation.surface: A drinker declines ice in a sharp drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rocks' looks like ice cubes but it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something without sugar can taste tart, so sharp is one example of the quality.

clue.text: Really amazing length, initially, in long sweet

indicators.note: in places the three opening letters inside the word for long

parts.note: to long for something is to pine

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letter of each of the three words before it

explanation.surface: Praise for a remarkable stretch of a lengthy confection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' covers all three words, giving RAL, which goes 'in' PINE.
explanation.definitionFit: A confection of nuts in caramelised sugar is a sweet.

clue.text: Light tanner spread on first of lotion

indicators.note: in an across clue, one piece on another follows it
first of takes the opening letter of the word lotion
spread means the letters of tanner are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: A sun-tan product applied over a first coat of lotion.
explanation.walkthrough: In an across clue 'on' places the anagram, made by 'spread', after the first letter of lotion.
explanation.definitionFit: A lamp in a protective case is a portable light.

clue.text: Animal seized by cheetah or seal

indicators.note: seized by says the animal is held within the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A creature caught by either a big cat or a marine mammal.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoofed beast that is ridden is an animal.

clue.text: Up to speed, with kit on when playing

indicators.note: playing suggests the letters of the words kit on when are put into play in a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Getting ready for a match by putting on your sports gear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link; 'playing' rearranges the nine letters of KIT ON WHEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Being fully informed about current matters is an idiom for being up to date.

clue.text: Journey in the countryside on your bike!

definitions.meaning: to go for a long walk through fields and hills
British slang telling someone to go away

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means both to set off on a rural walk and, as a dismissal, to clear off.

clue.text: Quick kiss ending holiday

parts.note: a short holiday is a break
to neck is to kiss and cuddle, and ending places it at the close of the holiday

explanation.surface: A fleeting peck brings a holiday to a close.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quick kiss' looks like one unit, a peck, but 'Quick' is the definition; the kiss comes at the end of the holiday, as 'ending' says.
explanation.definitionFit: Dangerously fast speed is described as headlong and reckless.

clue.text: Unreasonably demanding type, thesp in retirement?

parts.note: someone retired from a job is an ex
thesp is short for thespian, a stage performer

explanation.surface: A demanding retired performer.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who insists on extorting more than is due is a harsh, demanding person.

clue.text: Where freezer is perhaps found, tick off chicken

indicators.note: off, as in gone wrong, signals the letters of tick are disordered

parts.note: a hen is a chicken

explanation.surface: Ticking off a chicken from the frozen goods list.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tick off' reads as scold; 'off' rearranges TICK to KITC.
explanation.definitionFit: A domestic room for cooking usually holds the freezer.

clue.text: Profanity as son fills in solution

indicators.note: fills in says the letter for son goes inside the other word

parts.note: a solution to a problem is a cure

explanation.surface: Swearing when a boy completes the answers on a puzzle.
explanation.definitionFit: A swear word or oath is a profanity.

clue.text: Showing style with a turn in Broadway musical

parts.note: chic is stylishness
a go is a turn in a game

explanation.surface: A stylish performer with a twirl in a Broadway show.
explanation.definitionFit: A Kander and Ebb jazz-age show is a Broadway musical.

clue.text: Polluted air wrong for fruit

indicators.note: polluted means the letters of air are corrupted into a new order

parts.note: a wrong is a sin

explanation.surface: Dirty air is bad for fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: A dried grape is a fruit.

clue.text: Spare weight put under pressure

parts.note: spare in the sense of thin, with little flesh, means lean
a ton is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: Extra weight is placed under a press.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spare' looks like extra, but here it means thin.
explanation.definitionFit: To pressure or coerce someone is the idiom of bearing down on them.

clue.text: Elbow uncovered, dressing good

indicators.note: dressing, as a verb, says the naked word clothes the letter for good

parts.note: uncovered means nude

explanation.surface: A bare elbow, with a good bandage on it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dressing' looks like a bandage; here NUDE dresses G, wrapping round it.
explanation.definitionFit: To elbow someone is to poke or push them gently.

clue.text: Ridiculous, like number preceded by one

indicators.note: preceded by puts the letter for one in front of the number

parts.note: like in the sense of in the manner of means as
I is the Roman numeral for one
nine is a number

explanation.surface: Saying something absurd is like a figure with one in front of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Foolish and silly behaviour is described as absurd or ridiculous.

clue.text: Along with unnamed others, he had scored

parts.note: etc, short for et cetera, stands for the others not named
he had contracts to he'd

explanation.surface: A footballer notes that he and some teammates found the net.
explanation.walkthrough: 'scored' suggests goals, but here it means cut lines into a surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Lines cut into a surface, as by an engraver, are incised marks.

clue.text: Picture that is to include mother and mother's ruin!

indicators.note: to include says the abbreviation for that is wraps round the other pieces

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is
ma is a familiar word for mother
mother's ruin is an old British slang name for gin

explanation.surface: A portrait that shows a mother next to a gin bottle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mother's ruin' is British slang for gin, from its Victorian reputation.
explanation.definitionFit: To picture something is to form a mental image of it.

clue.text: Keep oregano for stirring in tea

indicators.note: for stirring says the letters of keep oregano are mixed up like a brew

explanation.surface: Advice to save some herb to stir into a cuppa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' is a link; 'for stirring' rearranges KEEP OREGANO.
explanation.definitionFit: A grade of black leaf from India and Sri Lanka is a type of tea.
